kind: approved design decisions, not production settings

decisions.title: Dark theme palette
decisions.notes: I like the dark theme. I also like the light theme, but I think that the left pane for the light theme should be lighter, not it feels to dark for a light there

decisions.title: Logo direction
decisions.notes: The blade ring symbol and typography is excellnet

decisions.title: Clicking the logo and name
decisions.choice: Return to Meanline; preserve the design

decisions.title: Workspace navigation
decisions.notes: Put the light/dark selector as the right most option of the top pane

decisions.title: Sliders
decisions.choice: Remove sliders from the default view

decisions.title: App edition to redesign
decisions.choice: Optimization edition first; shared resources reusable

decisions.title: Changing the inlet property pair
decisions.choice: Convert from valid state, otherwise request both values

decisions.title: Meaning of the meridional axis always starting at zero
decisions.choice: Zero on initial view and reset; allow manual radial zoom

decisions.title: Optimization configuration label
decisions.choice: Use Configuration for the objective and solver-settings tab

decisions.title: Compact contained editors
decisions.choice: Expand stage subsections inline within their parent; align optimization values in three columns
decisions.notes: Variable rows show Lower, Initial and Upper. Constraint rows show Comparison, Target and Scale, with contextual help.

decisions.title: Optimization quantity and group selection
decisions.choice: Searchable hierarchical checkbox menus with editable presets
decisions.notes: Organize quantities by overall scope, named stage and blade row. Checking adds missing members while preserving edits; unchecking removes matching members. Groups reflect partial selection and share existing rows. Presets follow axial/radial applicability and hold one reference work weight fixed.
